svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Production record, last 12 months
svg.desc: 2,788 successful production deployments across 47 projects since 16 Feb 2026. 12,233 contributions in the last 12 months, 86% of them in private repositories. 265 active days of the last 365. Below the totals, daily activity is drawn as a waveform with one line per day.
svg.text: One line per day. 86% of the work is in private repositories; only totals are shown.
